To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the lasso estimator is not consistent in estimating the number of nonzero coefficients, (b) the lasso estimate of the number of nonzero parameters can be made consistent with a simple post-estimation procedure that uses the bootstrap, and (c) the bootstrap procedure is not necessary when the true number of nonzero coefficients is large

(1) the lasso does not have a significance test; (2) the lasso is not a model; (3) the lasso has no p-value; (4) the lasso cannot estimate the standard error of the regression coefficients; and (5) the lasso should not be used to make inferences.
